headline: OpenAI has added Intelligent UI to ChatGPT, letting its GPT-6 model answer with interactive charts, buttons, forms and small tools as well as text.
score_reason: Pool score 5 lowered by 1: OpenAI announced it on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026 and the free-plan rollout began on 15 Oct, both before the 16 Oct window.
importance_line: ChatGPT users on every plan get answers they can click and use, which makes the chatbot behave more like an app, but how well the generated interfaces work has not been independently tested.
summary: Mashable reports that OpenAI announced Intelligent UI on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026, a ChatGPT feature in which the GPT-6 model builds interactive answers, such as a diagram of a bicycle, a GDP graph or a bill-splitting calculator, from a library of ready-made components. It is rolling out to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users from Wednesday and to Free and Go users from Thursday, and ChatGPT still replies in plain text when that suits the question best.
notes: Read Mashable in full. Mashable's parent company, Ziff Davis, disclosed that it sued OpenAI in April 2025 over copyright. GPT-6 launched for paid ChatGPT in September, replacing GPT-5.6, per Mashable; Intelligent UI was not in that rollout.
